## Names

<a id="title_menu_loop"></a>
### [`title_menu_loop`](../../../src/title_menu.asm#L14) `$08B1`

*routine*

Title menu loop (state machine of the title screen). Called by show_title_screen; returns when a game starts (the caller falls into start_new_game). Each pass: - title_countdown (decremented by irq_title_frame) zero: jump to start_attract_demo. - a key: F7 starts the game; F3 toggles 1/2 players (option_two_players); F5 toggles computer/human Yamo (option_yamo_player2); L, R, shift-L, shift-R set the joystick handedness and print a message. Each option key restarts the countdown. - about 350 frames after the last option key the message row is cleared (message $0E). - fire on joystick port 1 starts the game. Starting waits until fire is released on both ports, then 16 frames, and returns.

- **Called from:** [`show_title_screen`](title_demo_start.md#show_title_screen) [`$070B`](../../../src/title_demo_start.asm#L278), [`title_menu_function_keys`](title_menu.md#title_menu_function_keys) [`$0929`](../../../src/title_menu.asm#L79)
- **Jumped to from:** [`title_menu_function_keys`](title_menu.md#title_menu_function_keys) [`$08FA`](../../../src/title_menu.asm#L51)
- **Calls:** [`start_attract_demo`](title_demo_start.md#start_attract_demo), [`scan_keyboard`](keyboard_scan.md#scan_keyboard), [`title_menu_handedness_keys`](title_menu.md#title_menu_handedness_keys)
- **Jumps to:** [`title_menu_check_message_timeout`](title_menu.md#title_menu_check_message_timeout)
- **Reads:** [`title_countdown`](../memory-map.md#title_countdown), [`title_countdown+1`](../memory-map.md#title_countdown), [`key_ready`](../memory-map.md#key_ready), [`key_code`](../memory-map.md#key_code)

<a id="title_menu_handedness_keys"></a>
### [`title_menu_handedness_keys`](../../../src/title_menu.asm#L107) `$0956`

*label*

Handedness keys. Input: A = key code. L ($2A) and R ($11, matrix column 2 row 1; D would be $12) set joystick 1 (joystick_right_handed), shift-L ($AA) and shift-R ($91) set joystick 2 (joystick_right_handed+1): 0 = left-handed, 1 = right-handed (the default). Each prints its message (8, 9, $0A, $0D) at double row 10, column 2, then goes to title_menu_option_changed. Other keys go to title_menu_function_keys.

- **Called from:** [`title_menu_loop`](title_menu.md#title_menu_loop) [`$08CF`](../../../src/title_menu.asm#L28)
- **Calls:** [`title_menu_function_keys`](title_menu.md#title_menu_function_keys), [`print_message`](actor_driver_text.md#print_message)
- **Jumps to:** [`title_menu_option_changed`](title_menu.md#title_menu_option_changed)
- **Writes:** [`joystick_right_handed`](room_enemy_tables.md#joystick_right_handed), [`joystick_right_handed+1`](room_enemy_tables.md#joystick_right_handed)
- **Refers to:** [`joystick_right_handed`](room_enemy_tables.md#joystick_right_handed)

<a id="title_music_skip_count"></a>
### [`title_music_skip_count`](../../../src/title_menu.asm#L163) `$09BB`

*variable*

Title tune counter. show_title_screen decrements it and plays the tune when it goes below zero, then sets it to 4. 0 at load; lose_fall sets 0 when the demo ends, and the S key (handle_game_keys_check_s) sets 0.

- **Read by:** [`show_title_screen`](title_demo_start.md#show_title_screen) [`$06C2`](../../../src/title_demo_start.asm#L231)
- **Written by:** [`show_title_screen`](title_demo_start.md#show_title_screen) [`$06C2`](../../../src/title_demo_start.asm#L231), [`show_title_screen`](title_demo_start.md#show_title_screen) [`$06C9`](../../../src/title_demo_start.asm#L234), [`lose_fall`](lose_fall_game_over.md#lose_fall) [`$1820`](../../../src/lose_fall_game_over.asm#L18), [`handle_game_keys`](status_and_keys.md#handle_game_keys) [`$1B58`](../../../src/status_and_keys.asm#L80)
